# G2

> > G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace, helping businesses discover, compare, and purchase software through authentic peer reviews and data-driven insights.

G2 provides comprehensive resources for software buyers, sellers, and partners, including review campaigns, integrations with platforms like HubSpot, buyer intent data, and market intelligence. The platform features scoring methodologies, marketing widgets, and tools like Flow Builder to help businesses leverage software reviews and market data.

## Key Topics

- G2 Data Solutions
- Buyer Intent Data
- Software Reviews & Ratings
- HubSpot Integration
- Review Campaigns
- Marketing Widgets
- Scoring Methodologies
- Flow Builder
- B2B Software Marketplace
- Capterra, Software Advice, GetApp
- Software Awards & Recognition
- Seller Resources
- Partner Programs
- Market Intelligence
- Category Leadership
